name: Exp_FRASMAv2
summary: This EA trades based on the FRASMAv2 (Fractal Adaptive Simple Moving Average v2) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal and sell positions when it transitions to a bearish signal, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于FRASMAv2（分形自适应简单移动均线v2）自定义指标信号进行交易。当指标从中性状态转为看涨信号时开多仓，转为看跌信号时开空仓，并配有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用FRASMAv2分形自适应移动均线指标作为核心策略信号源。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0（中性）变为大于0时产生买入信号，从2（中性/看跌）变为小于2时产生卖出信号。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及反向信号触发平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MarginMode枚举支持多种模式，包括基于可用保证金、余额、损失后保证金或固定手数。资金管理提供了FREEMARGIN、BALANCE、LOSSFREEMARGIN、LOSSBALANCE和LOT五种模式选择。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar参数控制信号触发时机，并包含新K线检测机制避免重复信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the FRASMAv2 (Fractal Adaptive Simple Moving Average v2) custom indicator as its core signal source. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 (neutral) to greater than 0, and a sell signal is generated when it transitions from 2 (neutral/bearish) to less than 2. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit in points, plus reverse signal-based position closing via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose flags. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MarginMode enumeration, supporting five modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin-based, loss-adjusted balance-based, and fixed lot size. Money management offers FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, and LOT options for flexible risk allocation. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses a SignalBar parameter to control signal timing, with a new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制仓位大小的百分比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot value

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：按可用保证金、余额、损失后保证金、损失后余额或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: normal_speed
parameters.description_en: Normal speed parameter for FRASMAv2 indicator

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 应用于指标计算的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to indicator calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal reading (0=current, 1=last completed)

pros: 使用分形自适应移动均线，能根据市场波动性动态调整灵敏度，适应不同行情
提供五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活度较高
包含新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓
止损止盈均可配置，且默认止盈为止损的2倍，具备正期望收益比设计
允许独立控制买卖方向的开仓和平仓，灵活度高
pros_en: Uses fractal adaptive moving average that dynamically adjusts sensitivity based on market volatility
Provides five position sizing modes with flexible money management options
Includes new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate trade entries within the same bar
Configurable stop loss and take profit with default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing directions for high flexibility
cons: 依赖自定义指标FRASMAv2，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行且难以验证策略逻辑
缺乏点差过滤和波动性过滤，在高点差或剧烈波动环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值较大，对小账户或短线交易不友好
没有持仓数量检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
代码中大量乱码注释（编码问题），影响代码可读性和维护性
cons_en: Depends on custom FRASMAv2 indicator file; EA cannot run and strategy logic is hard to verify without it
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, may result in unfavorable entries during high spread or volatile conditions
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large values, unsuitable for small accounts or short-term trading
No position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Garbled comments due to encoding issues, harming code readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量检查，防止不利条件下重复开仓
将止损止盈改为ATR动态计算，以适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum position count check to prevent duplicate entries under adverse conditions
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to varying market volatility

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失会导致初始化失败
缺乏持仓数量和同方向重复开仓检查
固定点数止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化
risk_points_en: Depends on external custom indicator; missing indicator causes initialization failure
Lacks position count and same-direction duplicate entry checks
Fixed point stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility changes
